claim: ESA-supported OB-ASTRA moves conjunction screening, collision-risk estimation, maneuver planning, and intent exchange onboard spacecraft.

provenance.source_title: OB-ASTRA: Enabling Autonomous Onboard Collision Avoidance
limitations: Conference project description rather than peer-reviewed flight results.
Compact satellite subsystem does not establish 10 mm SNS feasibility.
Energy, maneuver, communication, and false-alarm costs are not closed for SNS.
provenance.fact_summary: OB-ASTRA relocates conjunction detection, collision probability estimation, maneuver planning, and cooperative ephemeris and intent exchange onboard using standard spacecraft sensors and a low-power inter-satellite link.
provenance.inference_summary: SNS swarm models should separate mission task allocation from safety state, maneuver intent, communication confidence, and energy cost.
provenance.speculation_summary: Small SNS scouts may delegate safety computation to host or relay nodes while retaining minimal local fail-safe behavior.
